target.title: Screenshot proof is never hydrated, so realBehaviorProof is always "insufficient" for image-only evidence
target.body:
<!-- issue-loop-fingerprint: a36d80b49a57013d0cd469a0800649483eda18bbe1a4df61b382090bf547ede1 -->

I ran into this while using `Bash`: The review prompt says screenshots are valid real-behavior proof and that the reviewer may open linked artifacts from the provided scratch directory. But prepareMediaProofArtifacts() hydrates video URLs only, so linked images are never downloaded into proofScratchDir, and the reviewer runs sandbox read-only where sandboxPolicy() hardcodes networkAccess:false - so it cannot fetch them itself either. The reviewer therefore cannot view screenshot proof and, following the prompt's own rule ("insufficient when the evidence is ... unviewable"), rates realBehaviorProof insufficient with needsContributorAction=true. Video-proven PRs are unaffected. This is not local-only: .github/workflows/sweep.yml runs the review job with --codex-sandbox read-only.

I expected Linked screenshots should be hydrated into proofScratchDir (already passed to codex via --add-dir) so the read-only reviewer can open them locally, exactly as linked videos are today - and screenshot-proven PRs should be assessable on their merits.
Instead, Image URLs are filtered out before hydration, so nothing is downloaded. The sandboxed reviewer has neither a local copy nor network access, cannot view the evidence, and rates realBehaviorProof=insufficient / needsContributorAction=true no matter how good the screenshots are.

I traced this to proofVideoUrlsFromContext() keeps only URLs ending in VIDEO_PROOF_EXTENSIONS, so prepareMediaProofArtifacts() returns early for image-only proof and writes nothing to proofScratchDir. Since the reviewer runs sandbox read-only and sandboxPolicy() hardcodes networkAccess:false for that mode, the model has neither a local copy nor network, making screenshot proof structurally unviewable.
I verified that with Red-green on a clean clone of upstream main at c17589a56c, using the project's own exported test hook and test helpers: a .png proof URL returns [] from proofVideoUrlsFromContextForTest (RED - never hydrated) while an otherwise identical .mov URL returns the URL (GREEN control - hydrated). Only the extension differs. Result: 2 pass / 0 fail.

Reproduction: Clean clone of openclaw/clawsweeper at c17589a56c, then pnpm install && pnpm run build. Add test/zz-repro.test.ts mirroring the existing video assertion in test/review-prompt-policy.test.ts:274, changing only the file extension, and run: node --test test/zz-repro.test.ts

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { proofVideoUrlsFromContextForTest } from "../dist/clawsweeper.js";
import { item } from "./helpers.ts";

const ctx = (url) => ({ item: item({ number: 1, title: "t", body: "proof: ![shot](" + url + ")" }), comments: [], timeline: [], related: [], pull: null });

test("screenshot proof URL is NOT hydrated", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(proofVideoUrlsFromContextForTest(ctx("https://github.com/user/repo/releases/download/proof/demo.png")), []);
});
test("identical video proof IS hydrated", () => {
  const mov = "https://github.com/user/repo/releases/download/proof/demo.mov";
  assert.deepEqual(proofVideoUrlsFromContextForTest(ctx(mov))<truncated>
Environment: openclaw/clawsweeper main at c17589a56c, clean clone, pnpm install && pnpm run build, node --test, macOS. Relevant code: src/clawsweeper.ts proofVideoUrlsFromContext() and VIDEO_PROOF_EXTENSIONS = {.mov,.mp4,.m4v,.webm,.avi,.mkv}; prepareMediaProofArtifacts(); src/codex-app-server-worker.ts sandboxPolicy(); .github/workflows/sweep.yml job review.

Raw observation:
- Command: `node dist/clawsweeper.js review --codex-sandbox read-only`
- Status code: `1`
- Output:
  ```text
  Red-green verified on a clean clone of upstream main c17589a56c using the project's own exported test hook proofVideoUrlsFromContextForTest and test/helpers.ts: a .png proof URL returns [] while an otherwise identical .mov returns the URL. Fix offer: hydrate image extensions alongside video into proofScratchDir (already passed to codex via --add-dir), mirroring the existing video path without ffprobe/contact-sheet.
  ```
- I observed it 1 time(s).
